name: SipArana Educational Web App
description: Sri Lanka's comprehensive digital learning platform for Grades 6–13 and University Higher Education, featuring Kavi Owl Mascot, AI Study Planner & Timetable Generator, Smart Flashcards, Student Study Group Discussion Corner, Real-Time Exam Countdown & Daily Goal Tracker, Voice Notes & Audio Summaries with live auto-sync, non-intrusive alert system, Google Student Hub, Free Courses radar, SipArana Book Shop, and multilingual support (Sinhala, Tamil, English).
